Bought 2 budgies in March and the poor little birds have been in the worst condition and health I’ve ever seen in a budgie. They’re very small also. Been unable to tame them which has never happened. They don’t really like healthy foods and behaviours aren’t normal for healthy budgies. Appear to fight death everyday. Was told one was male and other female, in fact 2 males, the lutino is a male, if they knew their birds they’d have known that.
They had scaly face mites show at around 3 months from when I brought them home which is the first I’ve ever seen in a budgie as well so I thought they were dying with cancer growth or something! Treated with Scatt. Every now n then I get hope they’ll be healthy but they are no comparison to my healthy budgies from a home breeder or budgies I’ve had in the past for between 5-10 years a life.
My cages are super clean, all real wood perches are properly sterilised prior to use, fed the best of natural organic pellets, some clean seeds and offerings of fruit and veg each day.  The feathers they’ve lost is unreal, lack of energy and chirping makes me so sad. I think Lutino is dying slowly and I can’t even give affection because they’re afraid of human touch which is something I’ve never ever had happen. Every day she is vibrating, then okay a while, at night falling off her perch and shaking to get back up. Can’t fly as her flight feathers gone too. Something is most certainly wrong with certain lots of birds this place gets in, because none of this has ever happened and is not due to environment as the other budgies absolutely perfect. We don’t use scented anything at home, only stainless steel on cooker and steel or wooden spoons etc, no sprays, no oils, we don’t poison our air at all yet this is happening.

My uncle bought a Budgie & it died, bought another one, days later its balance was off, eyes were streeming just didn’t look right. Phone the pet shop for advice person in the pet shop was extremely rude!! Telling him not to bother bringing the budgie into the shop incase it “infects” the other birds. He tried to explain he obviously bought it like that. Explained he would need to then wait to the budgies dies before he can get another one. That wasnt the case all he was looking for was advice. Thats some pet lover that working in a pet shop!!!
Very helpful and great staff love my new budgie

Traditional pet shop right near Queens Park in Glasgow. The shop itself sells a small range of furry and feathered friends. When we visited, cockatiels, Java Sparrows, peach faced love birds, canaries, rats and other rodents were on offer. Prices for the birds were on the expensive side but did look well cared for. The staff member that served us was very friendly and happy to answer any questions we had regarding pets supplies we were looking for or the animals. The shop stocks a reasonably wide range of goods for pets for an independent shop. Parking is available nearby. If we are in this area again we'll pop in and see if there are any feathered friends we want to buy. Thanks 👍

Natasha at The Creature Comforts branch on Pollockshaws Road, Shawlands, Glasgow is a true gem! 🩵
It is obvious that Natasha has a real love for animals and will help you with any pet related queries you may have.
I was impressed with the selection of birds on display. All birds looked happy, cosy and well cared for 🦜
Natasha took a lot of time with me and answered a lot of questions I had, nothing was a trouble for her.

This shop is excellent, a real treat to visit. It is difficult to find a decent pet shop these days - Creature Conforts have experienced staff who have a genuine love and compassion for animals. Including the animals you already have at home! 🐈 🐕  🐠

This shop is easy to find on Pollockshaws Road, at the corner opposite "The Shed" if you know Glasgow 🎶 💃 🕺 .....
With 'on street' parking, it's really easy for loading the car with new bird cage etc....

The next time you need to top up your pets food/treats/hygiene products, make your way to Creature Comforts, you won't be disappointed [ps, 4 stores in surrounding area! And great social media page!]
You can even call the store beforehand.

Thank you to Natasha and your team at Creature Comforts from Cheryl 🦜 xxxxx
